directPaymentDiscovery.scope: Official Stadtwerke Bad Homburg charging tariff sheet effective from 2025-03-01; no later official replacement was found during the 2026-09-09 audit.
directPaymentDiscovery.note: The tariff sheet explicitly distinguishes registered E Tanken app customers from Ad-Hoc-Laden without registration; only the ad-hoc row is certified here.

reason: The operator's official tariff sheet explicitly publishes AC and DC ad-hoc prices, start fees and blocking rules. The sheet is effective from 2025-03-01 and no successor tariff was located on the official site as of this audit.
